descriptions.w3d_d26e_distance_gain_801e5460: Distance gain of a 3D sound: emitter position (slot 14) against listener position (slot 17, kind 3), scaled by emitter slot 11. Below the near distance the gain is 1; beyond it falls linearly over near..far. The result times the listener volume (slot 16, kind 1) is clamped to [0, 1]. Range getters 0x801df1c4 and 0x801df1bc are read here as near and far; those names are inferred.
